name: @centraid/desktop-seat
description: The Centraid desktop seat: Electron main owns a `centraid seat` sidecar over a local socket and answers `centraid://` from it.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun build src/preload.ts --target=node --format=cjs --external electron --outfile dist/preload.cjs && bun run build:renderer
scripts.build:renderer: mkdir -p dist/renderer && cp -R ../renderer/public/. dist/renderer/ && bun build ../renderer/src/main.tsx --outfile dist/renderer/main.js --target=browser
